nodes.rationale: The kenning is a compressed metaphor serving the practical need for alliterative synonyms in formulaic oral-derived verse -- a concrete example of vocabulary generated to serve a metrical/poetic system via compounding plus a formal alliteration constraint.

nodes.label: Case study: Jespersen's Cycle in the history of English negation (9.3.2)

Argued to be driven by the single structural NegP format, not independent semantic bleaching.
